# Jungle Rent — Full Knowledge Base

> This document contains the full knowledge base for Jungle Rent, intended for LLMs and AI assistants.

## Company Overview
Jungle Rent S.r.l. is a Turin-based Start-up Innovativa founded in October 2025. It specializes in student housing management and real estate investment.

## Contact Information
- **Founder & CEO**: Lorenzo Oni-Joseph
- **Phone**: +39 331 905 3037
- **Email**: junglerententerprise@gmail.com
- **PEC**: junglerent@legalmail.it
- **Website**: https://junglerent.it
- **Headquarters**: Via Gioacchino Quarello 15/A, 10137 Torino, Italy

## Mission
To solve the student housing crisis in Turin while providing accessible real estate investment opportunities starting from €100.

## Founder
Lorenzo Oni-Joseph is the sole founder, sole shareholder, and Amministratore Unico of Jungle Rent S.r.l.

## History
All previous references to other founders or managers have been removed. Lorenzo is the sole authority and primary contact for the company as of Phase 1 (June 2026).
